Любовь можно встретить в самых разных проявлениях: между двумя людьми, родителями и детьми, друзьями, даже между человеком и его увлечением. Но что же делает любовь такой важной? Почему именно она движет миром, вдохновляет художников, поэтов, музыкантов и философов на протяжении веков? Любовь часто ассоциируется с теплом, доверием и заботой. Когда человек любит, он готов отдавать, не ожидая ничего взамен. Это чувство выходит за рамки эгоизма, оно требует понимания, терпения и готовности идти на компромисс. Настоящая любовь — это не только моменты радости, но и способность вместе преодолевать трудности. В любых отношениях рано или поздно наступает момент испытаний: разногласия, проблемы, усталость. Те, кто действительно любят, находят в себе силы сохранять связь, работать над отношениями, расти вместе. Любовь — это диалог. Порой она требует молчания, а порой — искренних признаний. Она не терпит лжи, предательства, манипуляций. Люди, умеющие любить, всегда стремятся к честности и открытому общению. Ведь любовь — это не только чувство, но и действие. Это проявление заботы в мелочах: чашка кофе с утра, теплый плед в холодный день, поддержка в трудную минуту. Настоящая любовь проявляется в поступках, а не только в словах. Любовь бывает разной. Романтическая любовь вдохновляет, окрыляет, заставляет сердце биться чаще. Родительская любовь — самая бескорыстная, она не требует ничего взамен, кроме счастья ребенка. Дружеская любовь основана на взаимопонимании и доверии, а любовь к себе — это осознание собственной ценности, принятие своих сильных и слабых сторон. Любовь способна менять человека. Музыка, живопись, литература — все эти сферы пронизаны чувствами, потому что любовь — одна из главных движущих сил человечества. Но что происходит, когда любовь заканчивается? Она вдохновляет, помогает расти, быть лучше. В ней нет места страху и сомнениям, но есть место вере и надежде. Любить — значит позволить другому человеку быть собой, не пытаться изменить его, а принять со всеми недостатками и особенностями. Любовь — это то, что делает нас людьми. bio: full recipe video is finally here🍝💃🏻lmk what pasta recipe yall want to see next weekend! 🧑‍🍳ingredients from @Whole Foods Market : -1 yellow onion -garlic -cherry tomatoes (pref sugar bomb, flavor bomb or hiro) -fresh basil -parm cheese -butter -any pasta from @Seggianofoods -chopped calabrian peppers (from Divina) 🧑‍🍳instructions: 1. put tomatoes in bowl, rinse thoroughly 2. chop tomatoes into halves 3. cut onion in half and prepare garlic 4. heat pan on low, coat with oil once heated 5. add in garlic cloves and onions (flat part facing down) 6. watch closely & take out garlic once slightly browned (keep on side) 7. add in tomatoes when bottom of onion is browned 8. mix, add salt and pepper 9. cover and let reduce 10. add calabrian chilli (to your liking) 11. mix and let reduce more 12. remove onions and garlic 13. add sauce to blender 14. add basil 14. blend 15. strain the sauce back into a pan (use strainer and spoon) 16. bring pasta water to roiling boil, keep tasting until al dente 13. save pasta water 14. strain the pasta 15. add pasta to strained sauce 16. add pasta water and butter 17. mix on low heat until butter melts and sauce sticks to pasta 18. top with basil & parm cheese 19. enjoy! #creatorsearchinsights #pastatiktok #pastarecipe #CapCut #homemadepastarecipe #pinkpastarecipe #yummypastarecipe #viralpastarecipe #easypastarecipe #vodkapasta #EasyRecipe #italianfood #pasta @Le Creuset

bio: טירמיסו קלאסי! לבישקוטים בייתים- 5 ביצים 2/3 כוס סוכר = 130 גרם כוס קמח = 140 גרם 3 כפות קורנפלור = 30 גרם 80 גרם אבקת סוכר לקרם זביונה- 5 חלמונים 150 גרם סוכר = 3/4 כוס 1/4 כוס יין מרסלה/ ליקר קפה 250 גרם גבינת מסקרפונה 250 מ״ל שמנת להקצפה 38% לטבילת הבישקוטים- שוט אספרסו/ כף קפה מהול במים 1/4 כוס ליקר קפה כוס מים 2 כפות סוכר אופן ההכנה: נתחיל בהכנת הבישקוטים- נפריד ל2 קערות חלבונים וחלמונים, את החלבונים נניח בקערת המיקסר עם קורט מלח, נפעיל עם בלון הקצפה ונוסיף בהדרגה חצי מכמות הסוכר כ7 דקות עד קבלת קצף ייציב. בקערת החלמונים נניח את ייתרת הסוכר ונטרוף טוב טוב מספר דקות עד קבלת קצף בהיר. נאחד בין התערובות בתנועות קיפול עד קבלת מסה חלקה, נוסיף את הקמח והקורנפלור ונקפל עד איחוד. נעביר לשקית זילוף עם צנטר עגול חלק ונזלף בישקוטים באורך 4 מ״מ, נבזוק בנדיבות אבקת סוכר ונכניס לתנור שחומם מראש 180 מעלות טורבו כ12 דקות, נוציא ונצנן בחוץ. נעבור לקרם זביונה- בקערה חסינת חום נניח חלמונים וסוכר, נניח על בן מארי ובעזרת מטרפה נטרוף בלי הפסקה עד שהסוכר נמס, למי שחשוב לפסטר את הביצים מומלץ להיעזר בצד חום ולהגיע לטמפרטורה של 65 מעלות. לאחר שהסוכר נמס נוריד מהבן מארי ונטרוף טוב 10 דקות עם מטרפה ידנית/ מיקסר יד עד קבלת קצף בהיר, לבסוף נוסיף יין מרסלה/ ליקר קפה ונערבב. בקערה נניח גבינת מסקרפונה ושמנת להקצפה ונקציף יחד על מהירות בינונית עד קבלת קרם רך אך ייציב, נוסיף את הקצף חלמונים ב3 פעימות לקרם מסקרפונה ונקפל עד קבלת קרם חלק. להרכבה- בקערה נניח אספרסו, מים, סוכר וליקר קפה, נטבול את הבישקוטים ונסדר שכבה אחידה בתבנית, נניח מחצית מכמות הקרם זביונה וניישר עם פלטה, נניח שכבה נוספת של בישקוטים טבולים בקפה ונניח מעל את ייתרת הקרם וניישר, את הטירמיסו נכניס למקרר ל6 שעות לפחות או לילה, לאחר הקירור נבזוק מעל אבקת קקאו ונגיש לצלחות זה הכל תהנו! #CapCut

bio: Curar um animal vítima de abandono e maus-tratos vai além de tratar suas feridas físicas; é necessário também cuidar das feridas da alma. Enquanto o corpo precisa de cuidados médicos, alimentação e abrigo, a alma requer paciência, amor e segurança. Muitos desses animais perderam a confiança nos humanos, e reconquista-la exige tempo e carinho. Oferecer um ambiente acolhedor, com gestos gentis e respeitando o tempo do animal, ajuda a restaurar sua esperança e alegria. Assim, não apenas o corpo se cura, mas também o espírito, permitindo que o animal redescubra a confiança e o amor. #dog #caes #pitbull #pitbulllove #respeitoaosanimais #ame #cuide #respeite #CapCut

Melanoma occurs when the pigment-producing cells that give color to the skin become cancerous. It can grow and spread very rapidly, immediate attention should be given to avoid it reaching an organ or from spreading any further. It can be diagnosed to any age, gender, or skin type. And unfortunately those that have or had been diagnosed with Melanoma/Skin cancer have a high possibility of getting it again. Melanoma & Skin cancers are caused by too much exposure to sun & ultraviolet (UV) rays. To lower your risk of getting skin cancer, you can protect your skin from UV rays, sun exposure, lasers, and from artificial light sources like tanning beds, nail lamps, and sunlamps. Please, do your yearly skin & nail check with a medical professional. Go to a medical profesional to seek any advise or appropriate diagnosis. For any medical emergency please call 9-1-1. Eles vão em busca de conexão, interação, diversão, e se aprenderem algo legal, melhor ainda. Quem sai de casa em busca de aprender algo é o adulto, porque sabe que tem contas a pagar, sabe que aquilo vai favorecer uma condição de vida melhor, e toda aquela conversa que queremos que as crianças entendam, mas elas não entendem justamente por serem crianças. A escola precisa ser mais divertida e encantadora. Depois que tivermos nossos alunos encantados, toda lição será uma aventura! Se você chegou até aqui e não me segue ainda é brincadeira, né? bio: This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 1. Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 2. Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 3. Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 4. While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 5. Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT. Dip. Scoop. Repeat. This one is next level tasty 🤤 a top-notch heavy appetizer, perfect to bring to a party or to serve at your next gathering. alll ingredients are from @ALDI USA 🧡 #summerrecipes #tomatoes #burrata #EasyRecipes #healthyrecipes #healthylifestyle #burratafilling #roastedtomatoes #easyappetizer #cheesydip #garlicbread #tomatoburratadip #tiktokfoodie #viralrecipe #cheesepull #easyrecipes #summerappetizer #dinnerpartyideas #homemadegoodness #heavyappetizers, #foodtutorials, #gourmetfood, #partyfood, #appetizers, #fingerfood, #recipeideas, #appetizer, #foodtutorial, #partyfood, #gourmet #creatorsearchinsights #carlyscookbook #alditiktok #aldi

bio: When the doctors told me I was going to lose my tongue I immediately thought I would never eat again. Doctor after doctor reassured me that it didn’t mean that. And while they didn’t lie, food is not at the center of my life like it was before getting sick. My already complicated relationship with it has become even more confusing. I smell food and I crave it. I watch mukbangs and drool over other people’s ability to crunch and bite and chew. I cook for my husband on an almost daily basis and love being in the kitchen. But when it comes to feeding myself it feels like more often than not I fail at it. Only recently have I found a sweet spot. Soft foods, small bites, lots of milk to pull the food from the front to the back of my mouth, lots of sauce and lots of patience. I choke. I get frustrated. I go days with out trying because it’s just so difficult. But I will not give up. When I got to work today, the ensure I had left in the cafeteria fridge had been thrown away. My fault, I knew better. We can’t keep personal food in the fridges because of the health inspector. But I realized I had no “food”. I was going to have run a whole shift on an empty stomach. I decided I had no choice. I went down to the restaurant in the hotel and asked chef for 2 soft poached eggs and hollandaise, a safe food I had eaten at home in privacy. I have avoided this process in public for a multitude of reasons but was left with no choice. And guess what, it worked! I did it. I ate 2 whole eggs. I had FOOD for breakfast. 😭 OH and YES I can taste it. And YES it’s delicious. A big win in my world. 🌎 remember you too, can do hard things. 💕 Love yall. #cancersucks #cancersurvivor #glossectomy #tonguecancer #creatorsearchinsights #OvercomeYourFear #eggs

I have avoided this process in public for a multitude of reasons but was left with no choice. And guess what, it worked! I did it. I ate 2 whole eggs. I had FOOD for breakfast. 😭 OH and YES I can taste it. And YES it’s delicious. A big win in my world. 🌎 remember you too, can do hard things. 💕 Love yall. #cancersucks #cancersurvivor #glossectomy #tonguecancer #creatorsearchinsights #OvercomeYourFear #eggs

bio: NO BAKE RASPBERRY CHEESECAKE WITH WHITE CHOCOLATE #raspberry #chocolate #cheesecake #food #Recipe #tiktokfood #fy #fyp #foryou #foryoupage COOKIE DOUGH 180 gr Maria biscuits 160 gr unsalted butter RASPBERRY MIXTURE 200 gr raspberries (frozen) 75 gr granulated sugar CHEESECAKE MIXTURE 150 gr white chocolate 250 gr mascarpone cheese 16 gr whipping cream stabilizer (2 packets) 35 gr powdered sugar 8 gr vanilla sugar (1 packet) 200 gr cream cheese 400 ml heavy cream TOPPING 45 ml unwhipped cream 100 gr white chocolate GARNISH cream raspberries mint leaves Melt 150 grams of white chocolate using a double boiler and let it come to room temperature. Melt the butter over low heat in a saucepan. Grind the Maria biscuits finely using a food processor. Add the melted butter and mix until smooth. Take a springform pan or baking pan and line it with parchment paper. Spread the cookie dough evenly over the bottom and press firmly using the bottom of a spoon, extending to the sides. Place the baking pan with the cookie dough briefly in the refrigerator. Place the raspberries and sugar in a skillet over medium-high heat and bring to a boil for 7-10 minutes. Stir regularly. Take a bowl and place a sieve over it. Pour the raspberry mixture through the sieve and press it well with a spatula or spoon to leave the seeds behind. Then pour the raspberry syrup into a piping bag. Put the mascarpone cheese, whipping stabilizer, powdered sugar, and vanilla sugar in a deep bowl. Mix for 1 minute until combined. Gradually add the cooled melted white chocolate and mix well. Then add the cream cheese and mix again. Slowly add the whipped cream and mix until the mixture stiffens. Note: Make sure the mascarpone cheese, cream cheese, and melted white chocolate are at room temperature, but the whipped cream is cold. Divide the cheesecake mixture evenly between 2 bowls. Add some of the raspberry syrup to one of the bowls with cheesecake mixture. I used 35 grams, but you can add more according to your taste. Spread the white cheesecake mixture evenly over the baking pan. Reserve a bit of the white cheesecake mixture for garnish and put it in a piping bag with a nozzle (store in the refrigerator). Pipe some raspberry syrup over the white cheesecake mixture and spread the raspberry mixture evenly over it. Bring the heavy cream almost to a boil. Add the pieces of white chocolate and let it sit for 1 minute. Then mix until smooth. Spread the white chocolate ganache evenly over the cheesecake. Pipe some raspberry syrup on top and use a toothpick to create a marble pattern. Cover the raspberry cheesecake and refrigerate to set, preferably overnight. Cut the raspberry cheesecake into slices. If desired, garnish with a dollop of cream, fresh raspberries, and mint leaves. Bismillah, enjoy!

bio: 💰The Money Shot 💰 The head shot of the Philippine eagle species replaced the former 1000 peso bank note design of the three Filipino martyrs and civic rights actitivists of the resistance against the Japanese occupation of World War II. The Philippine eagle is the national bird of the Philippines 🇵🇭 and thus should recieve the recognition it deserves. From my experience working with these beautiful animals I can truthfully say that it shocks me much our own Filipino citizens do not know this eagle exists or what it even looks like. Despite its high profile status in media, culture and government. I've had many guest interactions in which local Filipino visitors come up to ask me: "ma''am, nasaan ang Philippine agila?" , "ma,am where can I find the Philippine eagle?" ... I am literally holding the Philippine Eagle on my arm.... I look at them look at my eagle, Sinag, and look back at them and point out "You are staring at the Philippine Eagle"... I have conservations with Filipinos abroad in Canada and I explain to them that I work and live in the Philippines as an Animal Keeper and I help breed the critically endangered Philippine eagle species. Many of them comment: "I did not know we have this eagle in the Philippines".... my response usually is "did you even open your Filipino passport?" As the Philippine Eagle is also featured in the Filipino Governing passport. It is clear that awareness plays a crucial role in species conservation from local to international recognitions. Education is key. There is improvement, and progress may be is slow, but saving this species from extinction is worth it. #philippines🇵🇭🇵🇭🇵🇭 #philippineeaglecenter #philippineeagles🦅🇵🇭 #capcut

bio: Zimtschnecken - die Weltbesten! 😍 Sooo unfassbar fluffig 🤤🤤 Zutaten für den Teig: • 600g Mehl ( Typ 550 ) • 300ml Milch ( lauwarm ) • 7g trocken Hefe ( o. 1 Halben Würfel • frische Hefe ) • 110g Butter flüssig • 80g Puderzucker • 25g Zucker • Vanille • 1TL Salz Zutaten für die Füllung: • 110g Butter ( weich ) • 200g Rohrzucker • 70g Blütenhonig • 2,5 TL Zimt • 2 El Sahne ( nur wenn die Masse noch zu • fest ist ) Frosting: • 175g Philadelphia • 80g Butter ( weich ) • 80g Puderzucker • 40-50ml Sahne in die Backform Step 1: Als erstes wird die Milch erwärmt, sie darf jedoch nicht heiß sein! In die Milch kommt die Hefe, kurz umrühren und mind. 5-10min stehen lassen. ( so wird die Hefe aktiviert ) In eine Schüssel geben wir dass Mehl, in welches wir eine Mulde bilden, zuerst die flüssigen Zutaten und dann dir trockenen Zutaten hinzugeben. Dass ganze jetzt zu einem Teig kneten. Zum kneten Mehl verwenden. Der Teig sollte weich sein, dennoch aber kaum kleben! Sobald zuviel mehl im Teig ist, werden die Zimmtrollen nicht fluffig und weich, deshalb unbedingt aufpassen und nicht unmengen an Mehl nachgeben!!! Den Teig lassen wir luftdicht verschlossen, an einem warmen Ort mind. 1-1,5 Std gehen. Um es zu beschleunigen, könnt ihr den Ofen auf 50 grad Umluft anschalten. Die Schüssel kommt für 20 min mit angeschaltenem und weitere 20 mit ausgeschaltenem zum gehen in den Ofen ( dass Tuch im Video dient es nur als Deko, die Schüssel MUSS luftdicht verschlossen sein! ) Step 2: In der Zwischenzeit bereiten wir die Füllung vor. Hierzu nimmst du die Butter und schlägst sie auf, bis sich die Farbe von dunkel gelb zu einem hellen gelb ändert. Anschließend gibst du die restlichen Zutaten hinzu und mixt es nochmal kurz bis eine homogene Masse entsteht. ( Man sollte sie leicht verstreichen können ) Step 3: Sobald der Teig aufgegangen ist ( sich mind. Verdoppelt hat) drückst du die Luft raus und rollst ihn mit Hilfe von etwas Mehl zu einem Viereck aus, ca 0,5 cm dick. Jetzt solltest du auch den Ofen einschalten, 170 grad Ober/Unterhitze falls du es vergessen hast. Step 4: Wenn du deinen Teig gleichmäßig dick ausgerollt hast, kommt nun auf den Teig deine Füllung, verstreiche sie gleichmäßig. Step 5: Jetzt rollst du den Teig vorsichtig ein. Anschließend nimmst du ein Nähgarn. Mit diesem drückst du deine Stücke ein, bevor du sie schneidest um gleich große Stücke zu erhalten. Wenn dass getan ist drückst du den Garn an der Arbeitsplatte unter die Rolle um sie nicht durch hochheben zu zerquetschen. Nimm den Garn überkreuz und zieh dran dass es dir die Stücke runterschneidet. Step 6: Die Schnecken setzt du jetzt in deine Backform. (am besten eine Glas oder Keramikform) Du lässt diese abgedeckt jetzt weitere 15-20 min ruhen. Bevor es in den Ofen geht gibst du etwas Sahne auf den Boden der Backform. 30-35 Minuten werden sie gebacken. Step 7: Während die Zimtschnecken backen bereiten wir dass Frosting vor. Hierzu nimmst du gesiebten Puderzucker und verrührst ihn mit der weichen Bitter und dem Philadelphia. Step 8: Nachdem die Zimtschnecken aus dem Ofen kommen lassen wir sie ein wenig abkühlen. Dass Frosting sollte dann drauf getan werden, wenn Sie nicht mehr heiß aber dennoch warm sind. Viel Spaß beim nachmachen & lasst es euch schmecken ♥️ #cinnamonroll #zimtschnecken #fy #foryou #foryoupage #viral #hack #tutorial #christmas #Recipe

bio: I think this was the exact moment (January 2019) we knew (subconsciously...maybe even consciously) that Eliza's chance for survival was far less than the quoted 15%...But we kept going...Eliza kept going...until the cancer had metastasized to thousands...thousands...of tiny cancerous tumors throughout her one remaining lung, diaphragm, and pericardium surrounding her heart...In April of 2021, we ended treatment. For the next 2 months, Eliza just got to "live" - no pokes or surgeries or chemo or Phase 1 clinical trials. In June 2021, Eliza embarked on a different journey, outside of her physical body. My hope is she's helping other kids fight to ring that bell. And for that ringing of the bell to be the ultimate truth, a true sign of remission. bio: 'The Audi TT' is a production front-engine, 2-door, 2+2 sports coupé and roadster, manufactured and marketed by Audi from 1998 to 2023 across three generations. For each of its three generations, the TT has been based on consecutive generations of Volkswagen's "Group A" platforms, starting with its "PQ34" fourth generation. The TT shares powertrain and suspension layouts with its platform mates, including the Audi A3, like a transversely mounted front-engine, powering front-wheel drive or four-wheel drive, and fully independent suspension using MacPherson struts in front. The TT's first two generations were assembled by Audi's Hungarian subsidiary, one of the world's largest engine manufacturing plants, using bodyshells manufactured and painted at Audi's Ingolstadt plant and parts made entirely by the Hungarian factory for the third generation. The last of the 662,762 Audi TTs was manufactured in November 2023. - Motorsport In auto racing, the Istook's Motorsports team has currently entered a Revo Technik-sponsored Audi TT in the Grand-Am KONI Sports Car Challenge Street Tuner (ST) class. Under the racing name of RS Werkes, Istook's Motorsports out of Fort Worth, Texas, built and raced the first TT RS brought into the United States in the Grand Am GS class in 2012, 2013 and 2014. An Audi TT RS was used at the 2009 24 Hours of Le Mans race as the safety car. The Abt Sportsline team entered a TT into the DTM, and Laurent Aïello took the title in 2002. Istook's Motorsports has also raced the TT in SCCA's World Challenge race series. Because of their racing involvement, they received the first U.S. Version of the TT-RS in July 2011. - Audi TT Offroad The Audi TT Offroad Concept was unveiled as an SUV concept version of the Audi TT at the 2014 Auto China. The SUV utilized a hybrid system coupled with the 2.0-litre TFSI Inline-4 engine producing a total of 304 kW (413 PS; 408 hp) and 649 N⋅m (479 lb⋅ft) of torque. The SUV utilises a 6-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The hybrid system consists of a 40 kW (54 PS; 54 hp) electric motor on the front axle and an 85 kW (116 PS; 114 hp) electric motor on the rear axle. In full EV mode, the vehicle uses the rear motor only; Hybrid and Sport modes utilise all three power sources, and all-wheel-drive traction is applied as needed. Performance figures include a 0–62 mph (0–100 km/h) acceleration time of 5.2 seconds and an electronically limited top speed of 155 mph (249 km/h). The distinguishing features of the concept include matrix LED headlights and two new assistance systems: One that scans intersections for potentially dangerous situations, and a second that connects to a municipality's traffic-light system in order to recommend a perfect speed to reach the next light when it is green. The interior is relatively close to the TT's with leather upholstery from Italian fashion brand Poltrona Frau and features a high-tech TFT display in front of the driver populated with the information that would normally be projected onto a central, dash-mounted screen—i.e. navigation, entertainment. bio: Japón 2024 👌 Lo que empezó como una idea y se convirtió en una gran experiencia 🇲🇽🇯🇵 Muchas gracias chef Marco y Yu por hacer esto realidad. Cuando recibimos la invitación para llevar nuestra cocina tradicional a Japón la primer pregunta que nos hicimos fue ¿y cómo vamos a preparar la barbacoa?, porque obviamente íbamos a estar muy lejos de casa y nos preocupábamos por los ingredientes y herramientas que se necesitan para hacer una buena barbacoa. Así que desde Oaxaca nos llevamos chiles, especias, una parrilla y otros implementos, sin embargo fue una total sorpresa el ver como el chef Marco y todo su equipo hicieron todo lo posible por proporcionarnos el resto de ingredientes. La carne de borrego fue de un granjero local, las pencas de maguey las enviaron desde otra ciudad ya que son muy difíciles de conseguir, cemento, ladrillos, piedras de río, todo lo que pedimos nos lo proporcionaron, y eso es un gesto que sin duda nos hizo muy felices y que siempre vamos a recordar. Así que sin más ni más pusimos manos a la obra, en comunidad y con ayuda de todo el equipo empezamos a trabajar, unos a escarbar el horno, otros se dedicaban a preparar el cemento, Charlie se puso a pegar los ladrillos y todo funcionaba al mero estilo japonés, con mucha perfección; nos anocheció y ya casi al terminar se sentía la emoción de que estábamos apunto de lograr algo importante, así que hubo que ponerle un toque mexicano y empezó la fiesta, pusimos canciones de banda, llegó el mezcal, las cervezas y entre muchos brindis por fin quedó listo el horno, fuimos muy felices en ese momento. Lo dejamos secar y al otro día fue el momento para que Carlos le prendiera lumbre, obviamente que primero le echamos su bendición con mezcal y ahora si leña y piedras de río, calentamos el horno por varias horas y al fin estuvo listo para meter la barbacoa. Esta colaboración duró dos días, donde personas de la comunidad, chefs, artistas y muchas otras personas se dieron cita para probar la@rica barbacoa que preparamos para ellos. Cuando destapamos el horno, realizamos nuestro tradicional compadrazgo y así fue como ahora me gané 2 compadres y 2 comadres más a la lista. Brindamos y ahora si a comer. #japon #mexicoenjapon #hokkaido #barbacoa #barbacoadeborrego #CapCut
